run_experiments: run multiple RL experiments in parallel with GPU scheduling and max parallel process limits
run_hyperparameter_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep across many experiment configurations using the run function
run_gpu_balanced: run experiments balanced across GPUs by setting experiments_per_gpu to distribute load evenly
run_with_env_vars: run experiments with custom environment variables passed via exp_env_vars in the run description
run_with_pause: run experiments with a configurable pause_between delay to stagger process startup timing
